svg.text: SW corner: conditional roof-to-grid station
Source-bound structural trial · no selection, capacity or construction release
A PLAN · structural/core footprint
300 × 300 pier; 133 projects into room.
Black: roof action axis. Red: trial tie centres.
Core 140; pier centroid +80 x/y from roof axis.
Furniture and body-path checks are proxy geometry.
B SECTION · conceptual force route
RC pier: −80 to +6460 trial
Roof +68.111 / −24.325 kN control
Warm RC −80 to −380
AAC + beds + mineral DPC
385 gap to cold RC; no shear/tension credit
Cold RC −765 to −1215
4 × Ø20 continuous ties; Ø60 bores; 225 cold embed trial.
Bores breach DPC/air-gas boundary; seal, anchor,
lateral transfer and thermal performance unproved.
C SIGNED ACTIONS AND LIMITS
Roof-only eccentric moments: warm ±5.449 / ±1.946 kNm; cold ±2.214 / ±0.791 kNm (down / uplift magnitudes).
1 kN lateral unit: ideal fixed-ended bars ~61.3 MPa bending, ~0.76 mm drift. No wind, support share or capacity inferred.
Actual roof corner, pier/slab cages, cap-plate weld, wet boundary, diaphragm, site supports and occupied section remain to be resolved.
